verdict.rationale: Databricks publishes its own REST API reference covering types, paths, and request parameters. Many pages include request and response payload examples, and some show calls through the CLI, Terraform, or SDKs, so the examples can be copied and run. However, the reference is static: the docs describe no in-browser try-it runner, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec to drive an interactive explorer. Missing for 10: an interactive in-page request runner, runnable examples on every endpoint, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of the reference experience.
